model_info.description: A data model for Umamusume inheritance activation (proc) logic, based on datamined community info.
notes: SpecificAffinityScore is a hidden value calculated for each of the 6 ancestors based on Base Affinity (hidden per-pair values) and G1 win bonuses.
Green (Unique) sparks from the 2 direct parents are guaranteed at the start of the run and do not use this formula. This formula applies to the 4 grandparent Green sparks.

base_activation_chances.description: Base probability for a spark to activate (proc) during an April inheritance event, *before* affinity multipliers.

affinity_logic.description: Logic for how affinity is calculated and displayed.

symbol_thresholds.description: The visual symbol represents the 'Total Affinity Value' between pairs.
symbol_thresholds.note: Higher values above 150 (e.g., 200) still provide a greater bonus in the activation formula.

calculation_components.g1_bonus_description: Per unique G1 race won by *both* members of an affinity pair (e.g., Parent A and Grandparent A1).
calculation_components.base_affinity_note: A hidden, preset value for every character-to-character pairing (e.g., Teio/Rudolf is high) is the other main component. This data is not in this file as it is character-pair specific.

stat_gain_logic.description: Stat gains from Blue (Stat) sparks, which happen in two separate phases.

initial_guaranteed_gain.description: Fixed stat gain at the *start* of the run from all 6 ancestors' Blue sparks. This is guaranteed and not probabilistic.

april_event_random_gain.description: Random stat gain from Blue sparks that successfully *activate* during the two April events. Higher affinity weights this roll higher.

3_star.note: 3-star range is probabilistic and weighted higher; this 'max' is an estimate based on the initial gain value.
